The '''X34 Division''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] unit in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The X34 Division was equipped with [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|''Persuader''-class tank droids]], [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]], and [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire''-class droids]].
